**No publicly announced in-person events at Brisbane's cultural institutions (e.g., QAGOMA, QPAC, Queensland State Library, Brisbane Powerhouse, theatres, galleries, museums, libraries, or universities) were found for 11–17 May 2026.**

Searched sources yielded no specific, confirmed announcements for individual performances, exhibitions, lectures, or public programs at these venues within the date range. General calendars and major event lists (e.g., West End Central, Eventbrite, Queensland.com) reference sports like NRL Magic Round (15–17 May at Suncorp Stadium, excluded as spectator sports) or unrelated festivals (e.g., Anywhere Festival spanning May but lacking specific 11–17 May listings at cultural sites). No direct event pages from QAGOMA, QPAC, State Library, QUT, UQ, Griffith, or Brisbane Powerhouse matched the criteria.
